parrafo_1.en: Ruiz & Diaz is a Clearwater crew that handles residential painting, custom shutters and bathroom remodels. They do not sub out the detail work: they see every job through from start to finish.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes repiten lo mismo en Google: llegan puntuales, dan un precio justo y dejan el trabajo impecable, ya sea una ducha de mosaico, un cuarto recien pintado o una fachada completa.
parrafo_2.en: Their clients say the same thing on Google: they show up on time, give a fair price and leave the work spotless, whether it is a mosaic-tiled shower, a freshly painted room or a full exterior.

items.quote: They gutted and rebuild my shower. They did a phenomenal job with the tiling and I would highly recommend their services. The prices are fair and the work is neatly and professionally done from start to finish.

This company came right out to look at my project for pressure washing and weed removal. They gave a very fair price, showed up early the next day and worked on my lanai for more than 4 hours. My lanai was pristine when they were done.

We recently had the pleasure of working with an incredible shutter company that transformed the entire look of our home. From the moment we reached out, the duo behind the company was nothing short of amazing...
